__README__: MERGE THE 'meme_buy' KEY BELOW INTO THE REPO'S REAL config.example.json.
This is a fragment, NOT a full config file — it deliberately does not
contain the spot-bot settings, so it must never replace config.example.json.
Every value below is a SAFE DEFAULT or an OBVIOUS PLACEHOLDER.
As written this block is inert: armed=false, dry_run=true, both chains
disabled, and both token allowlists empty. Nothing can be bought.
Arming requires THREE independent things to agree:
2. MEME_BUY_ARMED=1 in the process environment (restart-only), and
A config hot-reload alone can therefore never arm a running bot.
NOTE: the loader rejects unknown keys, so strip the '__comment__' lines
below when you copy this into a live config.json.

meme_buy.__comment_armed__: MASTER SWITCH. Leave false. See README above.
meme_buy.__comment_dry_run__: true = log intended calls, move nothing. Leave true.
meme_buy.__comment_caps__: Hard USDT ceilings. per_trade must be <= daily. Enforced before the first money-moving call and persisted across restarts.
meme_buy.__comment_kill_switch__: If this file EXISTS the pipeline stops before every stage. Create it to disarm instantly.
meme_buy.__comment_db_path__: SQLite journal: caps, idempotency, crash resume.
meme_buy.__comment_arrival__: How long to wait for withdrawn USDT to actually land on-chain before giving up.

bsc.__comment__: enabled=false makes every other key here inert.
bsc.__comment_withdraw__: REPLACE-ME placeholder. Must be YOUR OWN BEP20 wallet and must also appear in withdraw_allowlist.
bsc.__comment_rpc__: REPLACE-ME. May embed an API key — keep it out of logs and out of git.
bsc.__comment_min_native__: Keep this much BNB for gas; abort rather than dip below it.
bsc.__comment_tokens__: EMPTY ON PURPOSE. v1 has no discovery: it buys only what is listed here. Empty + armed=true is a hard config error.

solana.__comment__: enabled=false makes every other key here inert.
solana.__comment_withdraw__: REPLACE-ME placeholder (the all-ones system address). Must be YOUR OWN Solana wallet and must also appear in withdraw_allowlist.
solana.__comment_rpc__: REPLACE-ME. May embed an API key — keep it out of logs and out of git.
solana.__comment_min_native__: Keep this much SOL for fees and rent.
solana.__comment_tokens__: EMPTY ON PURPOSE. See the bsc note above.
